items.title: Alterac Valley Adjustments in WoW: Forever - November 25
items.summary: Alterac Valley Adjustments in WoW: Forever - November 25 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) We’ve seen that players in Alterac Valley were frequently completing the battleground without capturing the objectives, so we’ve made some adjustments to incentivize a focus on the objectives rather than rushing to kill the enemy faction’s General. The intent with these adjustments is for Honor gains to be relatively the same and reputation to be increased per match. Additionally, the difficulty of enemy creatures inside Alterac Valley has been lower than intended, so we’ve increased that, and we’ve made some adjustments to how the Warmasters/Marshals and Faction Generals behave to improve their sturdiness. Player versus Player Alterac Valley Reputation and Honor from killing the enemy faction General has been significantly reduced. The reputation from objectives (Towers, Graveyards, and Mines) has been increased to compensate. Honor from these objectives has been slightly increased as a redistribution. Reputation from killing enemy NPCs has been increased. Damage and Health has been increased for all enemy creatures in Alterac Valley. Warmasters/Marshals will now leash if they leave their respective rooms, and they now aggro from further away. Generals and Warmasters/Marshals all are stronger if the objectives are present. Moon and Stars also grants Starfire a 50/100% chance not lose casting time when the Druid takes damage. Improved Starfire reduced from to 2 points (was 5 points), and now grants 8/15% chance with 1/2 talent points. Druids with 3 or more points spent in this talent will have all their talent points reset and unspent. Eclipse now also increases the critical strike chance of Wrath by 7/13/20% at all times. Moonfury talent removed and replaced with Dreamstate. Dreamstate grants the Druid 20/40/60/80/100% of the benefit of Innervate when casting Innervate on a target other than self. Moonkin Form now also increases Arcane and Nature damage done by 10% while in that form. items.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever Comic: "Al'Aketh Rising" Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Constable Aonda of the Skyborne travels into a remote settlement that appears to be under strict control. Prisoners march under close guard, strangers smile with an eerie conviction, and an uncomfortable silence provides cover for a growing threat. As she plays along to get closer to the truth, she finds herself overwhelmed by hidden agendas and fanatic devotion. And in a land ruled by wind, blind devotion can become a storm. Join Constable Aonda for a special reading of World of Warcraft: Forever's newest motion comic, “Al'Aketh Rising”. items.title: Lockboxes Hotfixed to Push Loot in WoW: Forever
items.summary: Lockboxes Hotfixed to Push Loot in WoW: Forever With a new hotfix pushed a few hours ago in WoW: Forever, players can no longer preview the loot contained inside lockboxes. Before this fix, rogues could use the loot key on an opened lockbox to preview its contents before returning it to the owner. Due to a bug, the preview showed different loot for the rogue and the owner, so players could keep re-checking boxes to fish for rare items and recipes. Lockbox exploit by u/intertiae in classicwow This change is similar to the one made to the retail world event boxes, which all got hotfixed to push loot on June 24, 2026. Previously, players could peek inside daily bags such as Satchel of Chilled Goods and Loot-Filled Pumpkin , then wait for another daily bag to "reroll" the contents and only loot the bag once it contained rare items. November 23 Update: Blizzard Working on a Proper Lockbox Fix Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Confirming that the change to lockbox behavior was made yesterday at 18:55 CET as a temporary measure. Today, we’re working on a proper fix that restores the ability to peek and partially loot lockboxes, and makes them otherwise work as intended. We don’t yet know how long the fix will take, but we’ll post about it when it’s done.
